settings.text:
i always wanted to write a book, a way to share my experiences, my lessons, and tell all the hard times i overcame, kind of a biography, but who would want to buy that?


today i tell my story without words, without paper and without a book.
each piece is a page left unwritten, a part of me i want to tell.


today the vehicle of my mind is the touch of the fabric, the cut, the design, the process, the vehicle of my beliefs is what’s called "marketing", and i manifest a movement that carries the values of the street and resilience in its veins, far beyond clothing.

i write this as a personal, mutual appeal, i want you to know that everything cena releases has a purpose, you are wearing art and meaning, created by you. if you still don’t understand it’s a sign you still have a storm to get through, and once you do and finally understand, we can finally say,

welcome to the cult


with sincere love,

the cena family

changing the clothing game since 2025
